nodes.name: 01_provider_activity.sql
nodes.summary: Verification query that monitors provider ingestion activity over the last 2 hours, tracking fetch counts, error rates, latency, and duplicate detection ratios to ensure data sources are healthy and responsive.
nodes.languageNotes: Aggregates provider_ingestion_log with time-windowed metrics; calculates noise ratio to detect data quality issues.

nodes.name: 02_signal_generation.sql
nodes.summary: Verification query that tracks signal generation rates and characteristics across engines and signal types in the last 24 hours, including signal strength distributions and directional breakdowns.
nodes.languageNotes: Queries signal_trace with FILTER clauses to categorize signals by direction (bullish/bearish/risk_on/risk_off).

nodes.name: 03_signal_evaluation.sql
nodes.summary: Verification query that reports signal evaluation outcomes grouped by engine, signal type, and evaluation window, calculating win rates and average PnL scores to assess signal quality and predictive accuracy.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses FILTER clauses to count outcome types and compute win_rate_pct as wins/(wins+losses) excluding neutral and pending outcomes.

nodes.name: 04_feedback_metrics.sql
nodes.summary: Verification query that aggregates the latest performance metrics for both engines and data providers, reporting win rates at multiple time windows (1h, 24h, 7d) and average PnL scores.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses DISTINCT ON and ORDER BY to fetch latest metrics per engine/provider, then UNIONs engine and provider metric sets.

nodes.name: 05_pipeline_integrity.sql
nodes.summary: Verification query that traces the full lifecycle of data processing cycles across ingestion, signal generation, and evaluation stages, using CTEs and outer joins to identify stalled or incomplete pipelines.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses three CTEs to stage ingestion, signal, and feedback cycles, then outer joins to detect which cycles reach 'complete' stage vs stalling at intermediate stages.
